description: This file sets up and starts an Express-based HTTP server with integrated Socket.IO for real-time communication. It configures middleware for security, request parsing, rate limiting, and logging. It defines a health check route and mounts various API routes for authentication, user management, and metrics. The server also initializes database connectivity and socket event handling before listening on a configured port.

classes.name: SocketIOServer
classes.description: The Socket.IO server class used to handle real-time WebSocket communications.

methods.name: bootstrap()
methods.description: The main async function that initializes the Express app, applies middleware, sets up routes, creates the HTTP and Socket.IO server, connects the database, ensures a default admin, and starts listening on the specified port.
